data.name: Rayyaa
data.gender_notes: Rayyaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is content with what Allah has given them, finds pleasure and satisfaction in their daily life and in their relationship with Allah. The name Rayyaa carries the meaning “Contentment, Satisfaction, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rayyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, satisfaction, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies inner peace and happiness, a person who is connected to Allah and finds joy in their faith and their relationship with Him.
data.etymology: Rayyaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment, Satisfaction, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayyaa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rayyaa has its origins in the Arabic language, which is the primary language of the Islamic faith. In Arabic culture, a name carries deep meaning and can reveal a lot about a person's character and personality. The name Rayyaa suggests that the person named with this title is someone who finds joy and satisfaction in their life, someone who is content with the blessings that Allah has bestowed upon them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rayyaa represents a deep connection with Allah and a satisfaction in His divine plan for our lives. The name is derived from the root word "Raa'aa," which means "to be pleased" or "to be pleased with." Thus, a person named Rayyaa embodies the spiritual quality of being pleased with Allah's will and finding contentment and happiness within that divine plan.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Contentment, Satisfaction, Pleasure" symbolizes A person who is content with what Allah has given them, finds pleasure and satisfaction in their daily life and in their relationship with Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rayyaa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of contentment, satisfaction, pleasure.

historical_references.context: Rayyaa was a wife of Umar ibn al-Khattab, the second caliph of Islam.
